searches.query: GPT OR Claude OR Gemini since:2026-06-21

tweet_pool.author: SakanaAILabs
tweet_pool.text: Introducing Sakana Fugu: a full multi-agent orchestration system via a single model API; Fugu Ultra matches Fable and Mythos without export-control risk.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Major product launch; positions Fugu Ultra as export-control-free frontier alternative. Highest reach in pool (2.6M views).

tweet_pool.author: Paul__Walsh
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic now requires government photo-ID verification before unlocking certain Claude capabilities; provider is Persona, backed by Peter Thiel.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete factual framing of Anthropic's ID-verification requirement via Persona. Chosen over higher-engagement 0xIlyy tweet (27.2h, out of window) because it is in-window and states the mechanism plainly.

tweet_pool.author: mark_k
tweet_pool.text: New ChatGPT voice mode rolling out to some users; the AI can listen and speak at the same time (bidirectional).
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete product rollout: bidirectional ChatGPT voice mode appearing for some users.

tweet_pool.author: karlmehta
tweet_pool.text: Zuckerberg: Meta's Llama race changes in 12-18 months; most code written by AI agents that run tests and improve the loop. Building a coding agent.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Company-strategy signal: Zuckerberg reframes Meta's Llama effort around a coding agent and AI-written code.

tweet_pool.author: aakashgupta
tweet_pool.text: A finished Guadagnino film with Garfield as Altman can't find a buyer; the script makes Altman a pathological liar and Ilya a key figure.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Distinct new angle on the Artificial biopic: multiple studios passing on a finished film. Different from the prior Amazon-drops-biopic item.

tweet_pool.author: 0xMovez
tweet_pool.text: Andrew Ng: 100% of my tasks are now done by AI agents; loops are next, in 3-6 months everyone uses self-improving loops, no more prompting.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Strong practitioner signal from Andrew Ng on shifting from prompting to self-improving agent loops; 438K views.

tweet_pool.author: ridark_eth
tweet_pool.text: Karpathy idea (16M views): stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain; point Claude Code at a folder, drop in sources.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely circulated practitioner idea attributed to Karpathy. Karpathy did not post in window; this relay is the in-window source (2.7M views).

tweet_pool.author: gdb
tweet_pool.text: Codex for testing every single feature in your app.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: OpenAI president Greg Brockman demonstrating Codex used to test every feature of an app; concrete use from a principal figure.

tweet_pool.author: ChrissGPT
tweet_pool.text: On the Sakana paper: one clean prompt favours a single frontier model, but messier tasks (delegation, verification, synthesis) favour multi-agent.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Useful analysis of when Sakana's multi-agent orchestration beats a single frontier model; pairs with the Sakana launch.

tweet_pool.author: ClementDelangue
tweet_pool.text: Not open-source AI leadership OR general AI leadership; it's open-source AI leadership BEFORE general AI leadership.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Hugging Face CEO framing open-source leadership as a precursor to general AI leadership; sober ecosystem analysis.

tweet_pool.author: rohanpaul_ai
tweet_pool.text: Study: as hidden worlds grow more complex, LLM agents fall behind and fail to turn evidence into a stable internal model.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete research finding on a limitation of LLM agents in interactive rule-discovery; adds a sober technical counterweight.

tweet_pool.author: thesamparr
tweet_pool.text: Half of Replit's employees are in sales; the CEO now calls himself a sales bro and shows up to at-risk deals.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Notable company-culture detail on an AI coding company (Replit) reorienting heavily around sales.

tweet_pool.author: cyrilXBT
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic giving six months of Claude Max 20x free to open-source maintainers; up to 10,000 spots, applications close June 30, 2026.

tweet_pool.author: haider1
tweet_pool.text: GLM 5.2 DeepSWE benchmark vs gemini 3.5 flash on score, cost and tokens.

tweet_pool.author: cyrilXBT
tweet_pool.text: London engineer Safi Shamsi shipped Graphify, turning any folder into a Claude Code second brain, 48h after Karpathy's idea.

tweet_pool.author: hrswatigupta
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic pays $750k+ for engineers who build LLM architectures from scratch; Stanford taught it in a free 1-hour lecture.
